properties.name: rei.external-agents.codex.command
properties.description: Codex native executable path or name; never a shell command string.

properties.name: rei.external-agents.codex.inactivity-timeout
properties.description: Maximum interval without stdout or stderr activity.

properties.name: rei.external-agents.codex.max-output-bytes
properties.description: Shared stdout and stderr capture byte limit.

properties.name: rei.rerank.base-url
properties.description: Rerank API base URL. Empty disables external reranking.

properties.name: rei.rerank.api-key
properties.description: Independent bearer API key for reranking.

properties.name: rei.rerank.model
properties.description: Rerank model name. Required when the rerank base URL is set.

properties.name: rei.rerank.path
properties.description: Rerank API request path appended to the base URL.

properties.name: rei.google.application-name
properties.description: Application name used for Google Calendar API requests.

properties.name: rei.google.credentials-path
properties.description: Path to the Google OAuth desktop client credentials JSON file.

properties.name: rei.google.tokens-directory
properties.description: Directory used to cache Google OAuth tokens.
